title: Roamhaven Rewards Member Terms: Linen-Share Courtesy
content:
# Roamhaven Rewards member terms — linen-share courtesy

On a cancelled reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, Roamhaven Rewards members get a courtesy on the linen share kept from the extra-guest fee.

1. A guest whose active Roamhaven Rewards tier includes a dedicated concierge has 100 percent of the linen share waived.
2. A guest whose active Roamhaven Rewards tier includes the priority support line but no dedicated concierge has 50 percent of it waived.
3. Any other guest has none of it waived.

The part waived stays in the extra-guest-fee refund, before that refund is rounded to the cent. The member's tier, its features and whether the membership is active are read from the guest's Roamhaven Rewards membership on record.

## Worked figures (hypothetical linen share of 15 percent of a refundable extra-guest fee of 80.00)

- Dedicated concierge: the whole 12.00 linen share is waived; 80.00 is returned.
- Priority support line only: half, 6.00, is waived; 6.00 is kept and 74.00 returned.
- No qualifying feature, or the membership is not active: 12.00 is kept and 68.00 returned.
